title: podocarpus matudae subsp. macrocarpus
intro: Podocarpus matudae subsp. macrocarpus, commonly known as Mexican Plum Yew, is a plant species that belongs to the family Podocarpaceae. This evergreen shrub or small tree is native to Mexico and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Podocarpus matudae subsp. macrocarpus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
